text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a stroll downtown, I notice a
certain
Umamusume in a store.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The color's cute, but I'd prefer
something
a li'l fluffier.

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
U-um! Excuse me. Are you, by any
chance...
Curren?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep! Thaaat's me!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text: O-OMG! It's really you!

text_block_list.name: Female Customer A
text_block_list.text: Curren's here?! No way! The real deal?!

text_block_list.name: Male Customer B
text_block_list.text:
I thought my eyes were playing tricks on
me! She's
even cuter in person!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I, um... I'm always checking your
Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Me too! I'm your biggest fan, and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, Curren Chan is
surrounded
by her adoring fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Considering she came here to shop, I
start to
wonder if she appreciates all this
extra attention.
However...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it must be fate that brought us
together
today. ♪ We should take a
selfie to remember
this moment... If
that's okay with you!

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Eh, a s-selfie? T-together?! Really?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'd looove to take selfies with

everyone else, too!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, buuut we should do it over there so
we don't
bother the other customers! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren's Fans
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Curren Chan spends
time with
each fan, giving them
undivided attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And without a hitch, she effortlessly
leaves all her
fans happy and satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey you, the trainer over there! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yep! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You were looking out for me, right? I
hope I
didn't worry you too much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You were looking out for me, right? I
hope I
didn't worry you too much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, of course, silly! They're my
precious fans,
so I didn't want to
disappoint them!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I think hanging out with
everyone makes
me look totes cuter!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Don't you think so tooo? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm blinded by the sheer intensity of
Curren
Chan's cuteness! No wonder she's
completely
captured her fans' hearts!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yep! ♪ I'm not in a rush, though.
Besides, I kinda
expected this to
happen. ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're such a sweetheart for worrying
about me.
Thank you soooo much! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm blinded by the sheer intensity of
Curren
Chan's cuteness! No wonder she's
completely
captured her fans' hearts!
